title: Show, Don't Tell Writing Technique
skills: replace abstract statements with concrete details
use actions, dialogue, and sensory description

alignment_note: Teaches the 'show, don't tell' technique by demonstrating how writers can replace general statements with concrete actions, dialogue, and sensory details. Supports descriptive writing, characterization, narrative craft, and revision across high school English and creative writing courses.
